item.name: Workspace Members
item.description: Member management endpoints within a workspace.

query.description: Include requesting user's membership info (default: false)

request.description:
Get workspace members with pagination. Returns members sorted by role.

Response data: WorkspaceTeamData (workspaceId, workspaceMembers, workspaceMembership?, pagination)

item.name: Workspace Invite

Get the current workspace invite URL with JWT token (valid for 30 days).

Rotate the workspace invite token, generating a new JWT and invalidating all previous invite links. Requires admin or owner role.

Send workspace invitations to multiple email addresses.

item.name: Project
item.description: Project management endpoints within a workspace.

request.description:
Get all projects for a workspace.

Response data: ProjectsListData (workspaceId, projects, pagination)

Create a new project in the workspace. The projectTitle is optional.

Response data: ProjectData (workspaceId, project)

Partial update a project. Both isDefault and projectTitle are optional.

Response data: ProjectUpdateData (projectId)

Full update a project. Requires all fields: projectTitle (string or null) and isDefault (boolean).

Response data: ProjectData (workspaceId, project)

Delete a project from the workspace.

Response data: ProjectDeleteData (projectId)

item.name: Domain
item.description: Domain management endpoints within a workspace.

request.description:
Get all domains for a workspace.

Response data: WorkspaceDomainsData (workspaceId, domains, pagination)

Add a new domain to the workspace. Domain starts with 'pending' status.

Response data: DomainAddData (workspaceId, domain)

Update a domain in the workspace.

Response data: DomainUpdateData (workspaceId, domain)

Delete a domain from the workspace.

Response data: DomainDeleteData (workspaceId, domainId)

item.name: Recording Links
item.description: Recording link management endpoints. Recording links are shareable URLs for capturing user recordings.

query.description: Filter by provider type: linear, notion, jira, github, shortcut, asana, clickup, height, plane

request.description:
Get paginated recording links for a workspace with optional filters and sorting.

Response data: RecordingLinksListData (workspaceId, recordingLinks, pagination)

Create a new recording link. If projectId is not provided, uses workspace's default project. If linkReference is not provided, uses "{firstName}'s Recording Link".

Body:
- domainId (required): Domain ID for the recording
- projectId (optional): Project ID, defaults to workspace default
- linkReference (optional): URL or title to parse for provider info
- linkReusable (optional): Whether link can be used multiple times (default: false)

Response data: RecordingLinkCreateData (workspaceId, recordingLink)

Update a recording link. At least one field must be provided. Note: linkGUID is immutable.

Body (all optional):
- linkTitle: Title for the link (max 255 chars)
- linkReusable: Whether link can be reused
- linkProviderType: Provider type (linear, notion, jira, etc.)
- linkProviderId: Provider-specific ID
- linkProviderRef: Provider-specific reference

Response data: RecordingLinkUpdateData (workspaceId, recordingLink)

Soft delete a recording link.

Response data: { workspaceId, recordingLinkId }

item.name: Recordings
item.description: Recording management endpoints. Recordings are captured user sessions linked to recording links.

request.description:
Get paginated recordings for a workspace with optional filters and sorting.

Response data: RecordingsListData (workspaceId, recordings, pagination)

Each recording contains:
- id: Recording ID
- recordingThumbnail: R2 thumbnail URL or null
- recordingDuration: Duration in seconds or null
- createdAt: Timestamp
- creator: { id, name }

Get detailed metadata for a specific recording.

Response data: RecordingByIdData (workspaceId, recording)

Get presigned URL for the recording media file from R2 storage.

Response data: RecordingMediaData (workspaceId, recordingId, mediaUrl)

Get presigned URL for the recording thumbnail from R2 storage.

Response data: RecordingThumbnailData (workspaceId, recordingId, thumbnailUrl)

Get presigned URL for the recording console log file from R2 storage.

Response data: RecordingConsoleLogData (workspaceId, recordingId, consoleLogUrl)

Get presigned URL for the recording network log file from R2 storage.

Response data: RecordingNetworkLogData (workspaceId, recordingId, networkLogUrl)

Soft delete a recording.

Response data: { workspaceId, recordingId }
